turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
You put a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me. Why?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Then don't. Answer the question.
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
Not a gray area. Your own procedure says software results don't establish a concern by themselves, so that's a machine's guess. What else do you have?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
Then give me something to read. Is there a document, or just the number?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing those down. I'm not the one explaining anything here, Hale. Turn the screen.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare every day; that's a wrong line, not proof of who wrote it. And you still haven't turned that screen.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Save the compliments. The screen, Hale.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Flattery isn't evidence. Show me the file or withdraw the zero.
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
I'm not here to write your policy. I'm here because my son has a zero he shouldn't have.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
No. You have a policy, and you didn't follow it. The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office before five.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
Are you now suggesting I wrote my son's essay? Careful.
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
I'm sorry? Then end this, or answer me. Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Students change their minds between an outline and an essay; that's what outlines are for. And you're asking the wrong person where his ideas came from. Ten minutes.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and I'll want the part about his record in writing tonight. But a rewrite for what, when you still haven't shown me a single page?
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Walk out, and I go straight down the hall to the principal. Show me the file history, or that rewrite is an offer to make me go away.
